meal-planner/features/custom_meals_desc: Toggle breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snack sections as needed.
meal-planner/features/print_ready_desc: Optimized for A4 paper, ready to print and write on.
meal-planner/features/shopping_list_desc: A dedicated area to write down your grocery list.
meal-planner/features/weekly_grid_desc: A full week layout with daily columns for easy meal planning.
meal-planner/how_to_use/step1: Set the planner title and select the week you want to plan.
meal-planner/how_to_use/step2: Choose your meal periods (breakfast, lunch, dinner, snack).
meal-planner/how_to_use/step3: Toggle additional sections like shopping list or notes.
meal-planner/how_to_use/step4: Print the planner and fill in your meals by hand.
meal-planner/note: Generate and print weekly meal planning sheets with customizable meal periods and shopping list.
